card.name: Capitalized TENDON in boxed warning
card.fires_on: The piece ON in capitalized TENDON right before RUPTURE in the fluoroquinolone boxed warning. It also fires weakly on pieces of other all-caps or letter-spaced words.

modes.label: TENDON in warning headline
modes.description: The ON ending of TENDON in the all-caps tendinitis and tendon rupture warning.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS ADVERSE REACTIONS INCLUDING TENDINITIS, TEND<<ON>> RUPTURE, PERIPHERAL NE

modes.label: Letter-spaced or capitalized words
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps brand name or a word spelled out with spaces between letters.
modes.example: D O S A G E A N D A D M INI S<< T>> R A T I O N A c

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece toward word starts beginning with r, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the end of the capitalized word TENDON in the boxed warning about tendon rupture.
